title: Pi background task bounds
description: Bounds for the project-local Pi background-task extension: captured output, finished-task retention and termination timing.

output_limit_chars.description: Maximum characters of combined stdout/stderr kept per task (newest kept).

finished_retention_limit.description: Maximum finished (completed, failed or cancelled) tasks kept; running tasks are never evicted.

grace_ms.description: Wait after SIGTERM to the process group before escalating to SIGKILL.

kill_wait_ms.description: Maximum wait after SIGKILL (and after output-stream drain) before reporting termination as not confirmed.

poll_ms.description: Interval for re-checking process-group liveness while waiting for termination.
